title: Ordinary sheaf Hom complexes commute with open restriction
statement: Let (X,O_X) be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let U be an open of X, and let L and M be arbitrary integer-indexed cochain complexes of O_X-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write res_U for termwise restriction to the localized ringed site over U [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. There exists a chain isomorphism Hom^bullet_{O_U}(res_U L,res_U M) ≅ res_U Hom^bullet_{O_X}(L,M), where Hom^bullet is the sheaf-valued Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex]. No K-injectivity, boundedness, derived categories or resolution choices are assumed.

source.place: Lemma lemma-restriction-RHom-to-U (Tag 08DL), construction of the ordinary Hom complex; sites-cohomology.tex, Section 0A8X

proof.text: Use homComplex_projections_exists on the global and localized sites. Restriction preserves integer-indexed products: compose with the forgetful functor to additive-group presheaves, where restriction is precomposition and preserves limits; reflect limits back through the forgetful functor. Apply isLimitFanMkObjOfIsLimit to the global product fan.

For each integer degree, apply overHomObjIso to every factor of the restricted global product. Construct the forward and inverse product maps with Fan.IsLimit.lift. Their composites are identities by Fan.IsLimit.hom_ext and the factorwise inverse identities. The resulting degreewise isomorphisms satisfy every product-projection comparison, including the reindexed forms p+n=q.

Apply lem-sc-hom-complex-restrict-open-differential to the constructed degreewise isomorphisms and their projection equations. HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents assembles them into a chain isomorphism; take its inverse to match the statement.

lean.statement:
theorem homComplex_restrict_open (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (U : Opens X)
    (L M : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ℤ) :
    Nonempty (
      homComplex (R := X.sheaf.over U)
        (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) U).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj L)
        (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) U).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M) ≅
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) U).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L M))
